relationships.subject: chronic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the NLRP3 inflammasome of endothelial cells was up-regulated in mice with CP

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: Both ablation of SCG and MCC950 inhibited NLRP3 expression and alleviated myocardial infarction area, endothelial cell apoptosis, and inflammation

relationships.subject: 6-hydroxydopamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemical sympathectomy of SCG using 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA) effectively alleviated myocardial injury, endothelial cell apoptosis, and inflammation

relationships.subject: bisoprolol
relationships.evidence_quote: bisoprolol not only reduced heart rate, but also decreased myocardial infarction, inhibited endothelial cell apoptosis, and NLRP3 expression

key_findings: Chronic pain raises sympathetic tone and worsens myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury via endothelial apoptosis and inflammation
Sympathetic-NLRP3 pathway contributes; SCG ablation, MCC950 and bisoprolol are protective
